verdict.rationale: The evidence pack cites Google's Discovery document for Drive v3 (googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/drive/v3/rest). This is a machine-readable JSON description of the API, including its OAuth scopes, and counts as an 'equivalent' to an OpenAPI spec. It is backed by REST reference docs for the files, permissions and changes resources. The probe's 404s at guessed openapi.json paths on developers.google.com do not contradict this, since the spec lives at a different host and in a different format. Missing for 10: a native OpenAPI-format spec, first-party docs describing how to download and use the Discovery document, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using it for agent or tool generation.
